about.pageTitle: Our Story | Hotel Royal Marina Suites Boutique

story.label: Welcome
story.title: Hotel Royal Marina Suites Boutique
story.paragraph1: Hotel Royal Marina Suites Boutique was created with a simple vision: to bring together the exclusivity, tranquillity and natural beauty of Lanzarote with the warmth of genuine hospitality.
story.paragraph2: As a family-owned hotel, we believe that luxury is found not only in beautiful surroundings, but in quality service, attention to detail, cleanliness and personal care. Our aim is to create a peaceful and memorable stay for every guest who chooses us.
story.paragraph3: Located in the elegant marina of Puerto Calero, our hotel offers a calm retreat where guests can relax, explore the island and enjoy the unique atmosphere that makes Lanzarote so special.

owners.label: Founders & Owners
owners.name: Susana & Miguel
owners.role: The vision behind Royal Marina Suites Boutique
owners.paragraph1: Hotel Royal Marina Suites Boutique is the result of the vision and dedication of Susana and Miguel. Originally from Gran Canaria and southern Spain respectively, they have called Lanzarote home for more than three decades.
owners.paragraph2: Their dream was to create a hotel that reflected the elegance, tranquillity and character of the island while preserving the warmth of a family business.
owners.paragraph3: Although English is not their first language, they are always delighted to greet guests, share a smile and, whenever possible, have a conversation about the island they love.

carmen.label: Department Manager
carmen.name: Carmen Rodríguez
carmen.description: Carmen oversees the daily workflow of the hotel, ensuring that every department works together smoothly and that guests receive the quality and service they deserve.

esmeralda.label: Head of Human Resources
esmeralda.name: Esmeralda Acosta
esmeralda.description: Although guests may not often meet Esmeralda, her role is essential. She supports the team behind the scenes and helps create the working environment that allows excellent service to happen every day.

jose.label: Reception Manager
jose.name: José Pimienta
jose.description: José leads the reception team and helps ensure that every guest feels welcomed, informed and cared for from arrival to departure.

monica.label: Restaurant Manager
monica.name: Mónica Rodríguez
monica.description: Mónica oversees Marina Restaurant, helping create a relaxed dining experience with attentive service, organisation and attention to detail.

antimo.label: Head of Maintenance
antimo.name: Antímo Valiente
antimo.description: Antímo helps maintain the comfort, safety and appearance of the hotel, ensuring that facilities remain in excellent condition for every guest.

commitment.label: A Shared Commitment
commitment.title: Making every stay feel effortless
commitment.text: Every member of our team shares the same goal: to make your stay at Hotel Royal Marina Suites Boutique as comfortable, memorable and enjoyable as possible.

intro.title: Curated Island Recommendations
intro.text: Discover some of Lanzarote's most memorable experiences, beaches and dining destinations, carefully selected to help you enjoy the island with ease.

timanfaya.label: Volcanic Landscape
timanfaya.title: Timanfaya National Park
timanfaya.description: Lanzarote's most iconic volcanic landscape, known for its dramatic lava fields and unique geothermal scenery.

catlanza.label: Ocean Experience
catlanza.title: Catlanza Sailing
catlanza.description: A premium catamaran experience along the coast, ideal for swimming, sailing and enjoying the Atlantic.

submarine.label: Puerto Calero
submarine.title: Submarine Safaris
submarine.description: A unique underwater experience from Puerto Calero, perfect for discovering Lanzarote's marine world.

famara.label: Wild Coast
famara.title: Famara
famara.description: A dramatic beach surrounded by cliffs, especially loved by surfers, photographers and sunset seekers.

papagayo.label: Protected Natural Beauty
papagayo.title: Papagayo
papagayo.description: Golden sand, turquoise water and protected surroundings. One of Lanzarote's most beautiful beach areas.

puertoDelCarmen.label: Promenade & Beach Day
puertoDelCarmen.title: Puerto del Carmen
puertoDelCarmen.description: A lively coastal area with beaches, shops, restaurants and a beautiful seaside promenade.

laPortena.title: La Porteña
laPortena.description: An Argentinian and Uruguayan restaurant in Puerto Calero, renowned for its premium grilled meats, excellent wines and beautiful marina setting.

sieteGotas.title: Siete Gotas
sieteGotas.description: An authentic Mexican restaurant overlooking Puerto Calero Marina, offering traditional flavours, vibrant dishes and a welcoming atmosphere.

laMargarita.title: La Margarita
laMargarita.description: A relaxed waterfront restaurant serving Mediterranean cuisine, fresh fish, tapas and local specialties in the heart of Puerto Calero Marina.

brisaMarina.title: Brisa Marina
brisaMarina.description: Located in Playa Blanca, around 25 minutes from the hotel, Brisa Marina is one of Lanzarote's most renowned seafood restaurants, celebrated for its fresh fish, shellfish and spectacular seafront views.

bodegaDeUga.title: Bodega de Uga
bodegaDeUga.description: Situated in the picturesque village of Uga, approximately 15 minutes from the hotel, this elegant restaurant showcases the finest local produce and traditional Canarian cuisine in a refined countryside setting.

socarrat.title: Socarrat •La Casa de los Arroces•
socarrat.description: Located in Playa Blanca, around 25 minutes from the hotel, Socarrat •La Casa de los Arroces• is a celebrated restaurant dedicated to exceptional rice dishes, traditional Spanish arroces and a warm, welcoming dining experience.
